reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves all eight supplied needs and marks direct coverage only where an exact capability need exists; the two needs without matching capabilities remain unsupported, which matches the assigned boundary role and downstream behavioral criteria.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve all supplied need records in coverage output
use exact capability matches rather than generic keyword matches
leave unsupported needs visible when no capability exists
independent market-demand support for the underlying needs

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs ranks unsupported needs before directly covered needs and uses the supplied provenance rank as the within-group ordering key. It also preserves the evidence_sources handoff through the consumed_handoffs metadata.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before directly covered needs
order each group by upstream provenance rank
avoid treating repeated history as independent corroboration

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation carries forward the ranked priorities and constructs the recommendation from the first ranked record: decision prioritize and top_need isolate faulty execution branches before replay. This satisfies the deterministic recommendation criterion.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from the first ranked priority record
surface missing or contradictory demand evidence rather than inventing it
